correctness.rationale: The last-coordinate decomposition \(E(A)=E(A_0)+E(A_1)+4\sum_z r_{A_0}(z)r_{A_1}(z)\) is exact. Cauchy--Schwarz, the inductive energy bound, and Kane--Tao's sharp scalar inequality give the claimed bound. Equality with two nonempty slices forces equal sizes, equality in both lower-dimensional slices, and proportional difference functions; equality of sizes fixes the factor to one. For a proper rank-m affine Boolean cube, integer independence makes each difference representation unique, and the nonzero differences of multiplicity \(2^{m-1}\) are exactly the signed generators, so identical difference functions force the two slices to be translates. Adding the last-coordinate translation gives an independent new generator. Conversely the product difference count gives energy \(6^m\). A fresh independent exhaustive check for every subset through dimension three reproduced exactly the affine-cube equality sets; the all-dimensional theorem is analytic.
